title: One-step behavior of the certificate guard
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, let $s$ be one of the $k$ tape slots, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each slot. From the configuration with initial state false, input head at position $1$, tape contents given by $w$ starting at cell $0$, all tape heads at cell $0$, and empty output, after one step the certificate-guard machine reaches the halted configuration with output $[\mathrm{false}]$ if $w_s$ is empty; otherwise it reaches the same initial configuration with state true.
hypotheses_covered: A family $w$ of Boolean words indexed by the $k$ tape slots
